name: romance
premise: Every plot obstacle is also an obstacle between two people who want to be closer.
obligatory_beats: a first moment of real attention, where one person is properly seen
a misreading neither party corrects in time
a cost paid to close the distance, or a decision to stop paying it
pacing_curve: Alternating pull and retreat. Slow the prose down at contact — proximity, hesitation, the beat before speech.
sensory_palette: hands, and what they are doing while people talk
the distance between two bodies measured in inches
what someone smells like from close up
pov_distance: Close third with interiority. We know what the POV character wants and why they will not say it.
dialogue_register: Charged subtext. The important sentence is the one neither says. Deflection, teasing, sudden directness.
taboo_moves: stating the feeling outright when a gesture would carry it
an obstacle that is pure misunderstanding and could be cleared by one honest sentence
resolving the tension before the last movement
